rows.evidence: Baseline lines 267-295 and 356-392 only verify process-group exit during failure cleanup; successful close returns at 361-365. Lines 857-869 fall back to an uncached build but pass the caught exception object to console.error. Lines 931-1004 load selection from the immutable exported tree, run prerequisite gates, build, then discover and execute native cases with zero retries.
rows.rationale: Preserve immutable source export, exact staged-index checks, discovery/execution equality, zero retries, and no-cache fallback. R1 already accepts ST22 success-path child characterization; change runner lifecycle only if that bounded check reproduces a survivor. ST23/ST24 also require the cache-unavailable message to use an allowlisted safe category rather than emitting the raw caught exception. This is a diagnostics contract mismatch, not evidence of a secret leak.
rows.depth: bounded semantic source read of gate, lifecycle, cache, selection, execution, and disposal paths
rows.limitations: No gate, process, cache, build, or test was run. The success-path orphan remains unreproduced; no runtime stderr was captured and no secret exposure is claimed.

findings.finding: The current account identity matcher accepts a broad family of files while mobile selection is attached to the original identity-form filenames. An extracted UI file in that family can therefore be selected without the required mobile engines.
findings.evidence: Baseline scripts/test-selection.ts lines 393-405 and 783-815; R1 understanding.md line 40.
findings.action: Carry the already accepted Q8/ST03 capability-based selection rule; no new scope or runtime claim.

findings.finding: The runner checks detached process-group disappearance in the failure path but returns on successful leader close without the same check. The source does not establish an orphan; R1 already requires a success-path owned-child characterization before changing process logic.
findings.evidence: Baseline scripts/test-runner.ts lines 267-295 and 356-392; R1 understanding.md line 72.
findings.action: Carry the existing success/failure/interruption/timeout characterization in ST22; modify the runner only if the bounded check reproduces a survivor.

findings.finding: When the native cache is unavailable, the runner correctly retries without cache but prints the raw caught filesystem exception object. R1 requires fixed allowlisted diagnostics and no raw exceptions; this is a safe-diagnostics mismatch, not a demonstrated secret leak.
findings.evidence: Baseline scripts/test-runner.ts lines 857-869; R1 understanding.md lines 74-76.
findings.action: Replace the raw exception payload with a fixed safe cache-unavailable category while preserving no-cache behavior.
